summary: Several Home render branches and transitions have no test: probe error heading (Home.svelte:49), non-CommandError coercion (api.ts:59), error clearing after success (Home.svelte:24), error replacing existing data, empty disk list (Home.svelte:115), disk usage line (Home.svelte:99-101), progressbar aria-valuenow, and style widths
